request.style: English, female solo vocal, warm and soulful, upright piano, double bass, brushed drums, muted trumpet, saxophone, melancholic yet hopeful, 90 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
Shepherd of Israel listen to us now
You who lead Joseph like a flock
Enthroned upon the cherubim
Shine forth with your holy might

[Verse]
Before Ephraim and Benjamin
Manasseh stands in the light
Stir up your power and come
Save us from this heavy night

[Chorus]
Restore us O God
Let your face shine on us
That we may be saved
In your grace and trust

[Verse]
God of hosts how long
Will your anger smolder on
Against the prayer of your people
Let the tears be gone

[Chorus]
Restore us O God
Let your face shine on us
That we may be saved
In your grace and trust

[Bridge]
Fed with bread of tears
Drinking sorrow by the measure
Causing strife to neighbors
Enemies laughing together

[Chorus]
Restore us O God
Let your face shine on us
That we may be saved
In your grace and trust

[Outro]
Let your face shine
Let your face shine
